basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas, who recently got into Reddit. I enjoy spending my free time watching gaming streams, especially Minecraft speedruns. I'm a fan of Dream and love discussing strategies and theories around speedrunning. I work in IT support, which allows me to work flexible hours and be online mostly during the late evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy connecting with people who have similar interests. Besides gaming, I have a passion for DIY projects and big-budget weddings, though I'm not planning one myself anytime soon!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in IT for the past 8 years. My knowledge is mostly self-taught through online courses and forums. I have a decent understanding of video editing and game mechanics, which I use to appreciate the technical side of speedrunning.
